title: Austin: Gas Stations, Streetlights, & Holidays
summary:
*   **Community Advocacy for Infrastructure:** The Council addressed a petition from Parent Teacher Associations for the Colored, requesting street improvements on Leona Street and new streetlights near "Negro schools," directing a cost and location estimate.
*   **Gas Station Boom & Strict Development Rules:** Permits were approved for two new drive-in gasoline filling stations, with detailed conditions for construction, drainage, and street-side improvements, reflecting early urban planning and safety regulations.
*   **Worker Holiday & Financial Scrutiny:** City employees were granted a holiday for Good Friday, and a policy was adopted to withhold payments to any individuals or businesses indebted to the City.
